entry.title: Validate redemption
entry.description: Ask the customer for their reward code and paste it here to see what you need to hand over.

field.label: QR code
field.hint: The code is meant to be pasted, not typed: it is 44 characters and case-sensitive.

errors.required: Paste the QR code to continue.
errors.format: That code is not shaped like a GeoQuest QR. It is exactly 44 characters and ends with "=".
errors.generic: We could not look up this code. Please try again.

preview.title: Check before handing it over
preview.irreversible: A redemption is single-use and cannot be undone. Only confirm once you have handed the reward to the customer.
preview.expired: This code has expired. Ask the customer to generate a new one in their app.

explorer.label: Explorer
explorer.note: The portal cannot show you the customer's name or photo: the backend only returns this identifier. Whoever holds a valid code is who can redeem.

Purchased.label: Bought with GeoPoints
Purchased.note: The explorer paid for this reward with their balance.

Prize.label: Awarded as a prize
Prize.note: No balance was deducted: they won it as a prize. A cost of zero is correct, not an error.

confirm.title: Confirm this redemption?
confirm.description: You are about to mark "{{reward}}" as handed over. This cannot be undone.

done.title: Redemption confirmed
done.description: "{{reward}}" is now recorded as handed over.

errors.notFound: We could not find any reward with this code.
errors.invalidToken: This code is not valid. Check that you pasted all of it.
errors.expired: This code has expired. QR codes last 30 minutes: ask the customer to generate a new one.
errors.alreadyRedeemed: This code was already redeemed. Do not hand the reward over again.
errors.notOwner: This reward does not belong to your business, so you cannot validate it.
errors.businessNotActive: Your business is not active, so you cannot validate redemptions right now.
errors.generic: We could not confirm the redemption. Please try again.
